end.parentNote: Navya practised answering who, what, and where questions and ordering story pictures. They used the picture sequence to retell the events correctly in order. A past-tense mix-up appeared, such as “take” and “sleep,” and it was not corrected after the last example. At home, ask Navya to retell a short story using “first, then, at last,” and gently model past-tense words such as “took,” “slept,” and “threw.”
